name: amp-loop-stability
description: Issue #42 (bench created by #10): bandgap_top servo-loop gain and stability margin with the telescopic-cascode amp (design/bandgap_amp.sch). Single-injection loop-gain probe at the one-wire fb break, swept 0.1 Hz - 2 GHz. Two criteria are gated: #10's phase margin at the global-minimum-|T| frequency (>= 45 degrees, unchanged), and #42's added Nyquist gain margin at the positive-real-axis crossing (gm_crit_db < 0 dB), which catches an encirclement of this topology's +1 critical point that the first criterion is structurally blind to. See the testbench header for both derivations.
claim: This design's own stability criteria (not ratified spec lines -- see design/bandgap_error_budget.md Sec 4): phase margin >= 45 degrees at the global-|T|-minimum frequency, AND the Nyquist locus of T crosses the positive real axis (if at all) to the left of the +1 critical point of the 1-T=0 characteristic equation, at every PVT corner.

pm_deg.description: Stability criterion #1, unchanged from #10 (design/bandgap_error_budget.md Sec 4): phase margin -- the angular distance of T's phase (evaluated at the frequency of minimum loop-gain magnitude, the worst-case approach to the Nyquist critical point) from the critical point's phase for this topology's characteristic equation 1-T=0, i.e. 0 degrees (mod 360), not the textbook -180 degrees that applies to a 1+T=0 loop -- must stay >= 45 degrees at every PVT corner.

gm_crit_db.description: Stability criterion #2, ADDED in #42 (strictly stronger than #1; nothing was relaxed): the largest |T| in dB at any crossing of the POSITIVE REAL AXIS by T's Nyquist locus. The characteristic equation is 1-T=0, so the locus must cross to the left of +1; gm_crit_db < 0 dB is that condition, and -999 dB is the sentinel for 'the locus never reaches phase 0 (mod 360) anywhere in the sweep' (which is what #10's amp does). Criterion #1 evaluates the phase at a single frequency and is structurally blind to an encirclement elsewhere on the locus -- see the testbench header for the intermediate #42 revision that passed criterion #1 at 179.8 degrees at every one of the 81 corners while oscillating with volts of ripple in transient.

dc_gain_db.description: Sanity floor, not a spec claim: the DC solve must still be finding the intended nonzero-current operating point at every corner (AC analysis linearizes around whatever DC point converges; a collapse to the degenerate near-zero-current state -- Sec 4.2 of design/bandgap_operating_point.md -- would show up as near-zero small-signal gm everywhere and a much lower DC loop gain than any nonzero-current corner should show).
